description: Prevent bad data from entering the system by replacing free-text wallet inputs with smart dropdowns, normalizing wallet names, adding duplicate detection to TUI imports, and trimming/validating all user inputs. These are quick wins that protect new users from the most common data entry mistakes.
principles: Prevent over Repair - Stop bad data at the boundary, not after the fact
Existing Wallets First - Always offer known wallets before allowing free-text entry
Normalize at Storage Layer - Trim whitespace and enforce consistent casing at the lowest level
Non-Breaking - All changes must be backward compatible with existing databases
Incremental Delivery - Each story is independently shippable and testable

userStories.title: Normalize wallet names at the storage layer
acceptanceCriteria: LedgerWriter methods (deposit, withdraw, trade, spend, mining, interest_income) strip leading/trailing whitespace from the exchange parameter before storing
CryptoAccounts.import_transactions() strips whitespace from exchange field on each transaction dict before passing to LedgerWriter
WalletQuery.get_balance_by_account() strips the account parameter before querying
Existing tests continue to pass with no changes (names already clean in test fixtures)
New unit tests: whitespace-padded exchange names are trimmed on storage and query

userStories.title: Add wallet selector to Record Transaction screen (Buy form)
acceptanceCriteria: Buy form replaces free-text Input for exchange with a Select dropdown populated from WalletQuery.get_wallets()
Dropdown includes all existing wallet names plus a '+ New Wallet...' option at the end
When '+ New Wallet...' is selected, an Input widget appears for typing a new name
New wallet names are stripped of whitespace before use
Default selection is first existing wallet (or '+ New Wallet...' if database is empty)
Existing preview and confirmation flow unchanged
Test: wallet selector populated from database, new wallet input appears on selection

userStories.title: Add wallet selector to Record Transaction screen (Sell, Transfer, Interest forms)
acceptanceCriteria: Sell form: exchange field uses same wallet Select pattern as Buy form
Transfer form: both from-wallet and to-wallet fields use wallet Select with '+ New Wallet...' option
Interest form: exchange field uses same wallet Select pattern
All four forms share a common helper method for building the wallet selector widget
Test: each form type shows wallet dropdown, new wallet input, and strips whitespace
userStories.estimatedLines: +60 (reuse pattern from DIF-002, extend to 3 forms)

userStories.title: Add wallet selector to Import Wizard withdraw-to field
acceptanceCriteria: Import Wizard step 2: withdraw-to Select is populated from WalletQuery.get_wallets() (currently shows empty list for new users)
Includes '+ New Wallet...' option with Input fallback, same pattern as Record screen
For wallet imports: wallet-name selector also uses the same pattern
When database is empty, shows helpful placeholder text: 'No wallets yet - type a name below'
Test: wizard step 2 shows populated wallet dropdowns

userStories.title: Add duplicate detection to TUI Import Wizard
acceptanceCriteria: Import Wizard step 3 (preview) calls detect_duplicates() from imports/validation.py on the parsed transactions
If duplicates found, shows warning banner: 'X potential duplicate(s) detected' with yellow styling
Duplicate transactions are marked in the preview table (e.g., row highlighted or prefixed with warning icon)
User can still proceed with import (warning, not blocker) - matches CLI behavior
Dry-run results also show duplicate count
Test: mock detect_duplicates returning results, verify warning shown in preview

userStories.title: Add input validation to CLI recording scripts
acceptanceCriteria: buySats: wrap float() conversions for quantity, total_cost, fee in try/except with user-friendly error message and re-prompt
sell: same float() guarding for quantity, total_proceeds, fee
transfer: same float() guarding for amount, fee
earnInterest: same float() guarding for amount
All scripts: strip whitespace from exchange/wallet name inputs
Test: manual verification (scripts use interactive prompts, not easily unit-testable)
userStories.testStrategy: Manual: run each script, enter invalid input, verify re-prompt instead of crash

medium: Wallet selector on Record screen changes compose() layout - must verify existing form logic still works
Duplicate detection adds a database query during import preview - could slow down large imports
low: Whitespace trimming is additive and backward compatible
CLI script changes are isolated to input handling, not business logic
Import wizard already has wallet loading infrastructure (load_wallets method)
